Apple Scab.treatment: Apply captan or mancozeb fungicide. Remove infected leaves and fruit from the ground.
Apple Scab.prevention: Ensure good air circulation. Avoid overhead watering. Plant resistant varieties.

Apple with Black Rot.treatment: Prune out infected branches and cankers. Apply fungicides like captan during the growing season.
Apple with Black Rot.prevention: Remove mummified fruit. Keep the orchard clean of debris.

Cedar Apple Rust.treatment: Apply myclobutanil or sulfur fungicides. Remove nearby juniper trees if possible.
Cedar Apple Rust.prevention: Use resistant cultivars. Maintain proper tree spacing.

Healthy Apple.prevention: Continue monitoring and maintain good cultural practices.

Healthy Blueberry Plant.prevention: Maintain soil acidity and proper irrigation.

Cherry with Powdery Mildew.treatment: Apply sulfur or potassium bicarbonate sprays. Increase sunlight exposure.
Cherry with Powdery Mildew.prevention: Avoid nitrogen over-fertilization. Prune for better airflow.

Healthy Cherry Plant.prevention: Monitor for pests like cherry fruit fly.

Corn (Maize) with Cercospora and Gray Le.treatment: Apply foliar fungicides like strobilurins. Rotate crops.
Corn (Maize) with Cercospora and Gray Le.prevention: Use resistant hybrids. Manage crop residue through tillage.

Corn (Maize) with Common Rust.treatment: Apply fungicides if disease is severe and detected early. Ensure adequate nutrition.
Corn (Maize) with Common Rust.prevention: Plant resistant hybrids. Manage planting dates.

Corn (Maize) with Northern Leaf Blight.treatment: Apply fungicides like azoxystrobin. Remove infected debris.
Corn (Maize) with Northern Leaf Blight.prevention: Rotate with non-host crops. Use resistant varieties.

Healthy Corn (Maize) Plant.prevention: Monitor soil moisture and nutrient levels.

Grape with Black Rot.treatment: Prune and destroy infected vines. Apply fungicides like mancozeb or myclobutanil.
Grape with Black Rot.prevention: Remove mummified berries. Keep vines off the ground.

Grape with Esca (Black Measles).treatment: No effective chemical treatment for established vines. Prune out infected parts.
Grape with Esca (Black Measles).prevention: Protect pruning wounds with sealants. Avoid water stress.

Grape with Isariopsis Leaf Spot.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicides. Remove fallen leaves.
Grape with Isariopsis Leaf Spot.prevention: Ensure good drainage and canopy management.

Healthy Grape Plant.prevention: Maintain proper pruning and training systems.

Orange with Citrus Greening.treatment: No cure. Remove and destroy infected trees to prevent spread. Control Asian citrus psyllid.
Orange with Citrus Greening.prevention: Use certified disease-free nursery stock. Monitor for psyllids.

Peach with Bacterial Spot.treatment: Apply copper-based sprays or oxytetracycline. Prune during dormant season.
Peach with Bacterial Spot.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Avoid high nitrogen levels.

Healthy Peach Plant.prevention: Maintain tree vigor through proper fertilization.

Bell Pepper with Bacterial Spot.treatment: Apply copper fungicides. Remove infected plants immediately.
Bell Pepper with Bacterial Spot.prevention: Use pathogen-free seeds. Avoid overhead irrigation.

Potato with Early Blight.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb fungicides. Ensure adequate potassium.
Potato with Early Blight.prevention: Rotate crops. Keep foliage dry. Remove plant debris.

Potato with Late Blight.treatment: Apply metalaxyl-based fungicides. Destroy infected tubers.
Potato with Late Blight.prevention: Avoid wet conditions. Use resistant varieties. Monitor weather forecasts.

Squash with Powdery Mildew.treatment: Apply neem oil or sulfur-based fungicides. Water at the base of the plant.

Strawberry with Leaf Scorch.treatment: Apply fungicides containing captan. Remove infected leaves.
Strawberry with Leaf Scorch.prevention: Use drip irrigation. Renovate beds regularly.

Healthy Strawberry Plant.prevention: Keep fruit off the ground with mulch.

Tomato with Bacterial Spot.treatment: Apply copper sprays mixed with mancozeb. Remove infected plants.
Tomato with Bacterial Spot.prevention: Practice 3-year crop rotation. Use clean seeds.

Tomato with Early Blight.treatment: Apply mancozeb 2g/L. Avoid overhead irrigation. Remove lower leaves.
Tomato with Early Blight.prevention: Mulch around plants. Rotate with non-solanaceous crops.

Tomato with Late Blight.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicides immediately. Destroy infected plants.
Tomato with Late Blight.prevention: Ensure good air circulation. Monitor during cool, wet weather.

Tomato with Leaf Mold.treatment: Increase ventilation in greenhouses. Apply fungicides like chlorothalonil.
Tomato with Leaf Mold.prevention: Avoid wetting foliage. Prune for better airflow.

Tomato with Septoria Leaf Spot.treatment: Apply fungicides containing chlorothalonil or copper. Remove infected leaves.

Tomato with Spider Mites or Two-spotted.treatment: Apply miticides or neem oil. Use predatory mites.
Tomato with Spider Mites or Two-spotted.prevention: Keep plants well-hydrated. Avoid dusty conditions.

Tomato with Target Spot.treatment: Apply fungicides like azoxystrobin. Ensure adequate plant spacing.

Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.treatment: Control whiteflies with insecticides or neem oil. Remove infected plants.
Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.prevention: Use UV-reflective mulches. Plant resistant hybrids.

Tomato Mosaic Virus.treatment: No cure. Remove and burn infected plants immediately to prevent spread.
Tomato Mosaic Virus.prevention: Sanitize tools. Avoid tobacco use near plants.

Healthy Tomato Plant.prevention: Maintain consistent watering and nutrient supply.

Rice Brown Spot.treatment: Apply fungicides like edifenphos or carbendazim. Balance soil nutrients.
Rice Brown Spot.prevention: Use healthy seeds. Improve soil fertility.

Rice Leaf Blast.treatment: Apply tricyclazole or carbendazim. Avoid excessive nitrogen.
Rice Leaf Blast.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Manage water levels carefully.

Wheat Septoria.treatment: Apply fungicides like tebuconazole. Ensure proper seed treatment.
Wheat Septoria.prevention: Rotate crops. Remove volunteer wheat plants.

Wheat Yellow Rust.treatment: Apply fungicides like propiconazole immediately upon detection.
Wheat Yellow Rust.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Avoid late sowing.

Wheat Healthy.prevention: Monitor for aphids and rust regularly.
